symptom: Single-touch actions returned success but produced no UI response after a multi-touch gesture; Android system BACK continued to work.

live_device_observation.conclusion: The Airtest multi-touch proxy left two fingers down in Android InputDispatcher, so later adb shell input tap events were accepted by the command layer but swallowed by the active gesture state.

code_fix.behavior: Always call device.touch_proxy.teardown() in finally; fail closed when teardown fails.

next_required_action: Restart the MuMu target through the leased Game Observatory gateway, confirm dumpsys input has no stale pointers, then record a multi-touch followed by a state-changing tap as atomic EvidenceSteps.
